text:
maria: heads up — nightly gpu-smoke red on h100 shard 12. Failure during model warmup; logs show OOM-like allocation failure and also 'invalid device function'. job: nightly-gpu-2026-03-16-12:03 commit abc1234. can someone quick-triage? link: https://ci.redwood.internal/1769992222 :eyes:

raj: on it. which image + driver on the node?

maria: image=redwood/rt-runtime:prod-2026-03-16 (cuda 11.8 stack). node driver reported 535.54. dmesg snippet below:
```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (79): 13ffffc3e;  GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 12345.679000] h100: invalid device function
[ 12345.679100] oom_kill: Killed process 2345 (python) total-vm:...
```

tess: h100 + 'invalid device function' often points at PTX/kernel mismatch or a JIT failure. did the recent test-harness PR change CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES / affinity?

oliver: we saw something similar yesterday on canary after a small kernel module bump. quick try: rerun with affinity pinned to one GPU and smaller batch size. e.g. run test with env override: `CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0 REDWOOD_BATCH_TOKENS=64` or CI flag `--gpus 'device=0'`.

maria: good call. @ci-bot can you rerun shard-12 with those env overrides? please tag for affinity-pin troubleshooting.

ci-bot: rerun requested by maria. queued: nightly-gpu-shard-12 (env: CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=0, REDWOOD_BATCH_TOKENS=64). rerun id: 1769992222-rerun-1. ETA ~ 10m.

raj: also recommend we collect module/info artifacts in case it's driver vs PTX. if rerun still fails, we should bisect driver versions (534.x -> 535.x). node shows 535.54 now.

maria: quick check from the failing node (snippets):
```
nvidia-smi --query-gpu=name,compute_cap,driver_version --format=csv
GPU 0, NVIDIA H100, compute 9.0, driver 535.54
cat /proc/driver/nvidia/version
NVRM version: NVIDIA UNIX x86_64 Kernel Module  535.54  Wed Feb  3 10:00:00 UTC 2026
```

tess: compute 9.0 + cuda 11.8 should be OK, but if some kernels were compiled for older sm (or PTX fallback ended up generating invalid code) you'll see invalid device function. please grab `modinfo nvidia` and `dmesg` full log.

infra-bot: artifacts auto-collected for job 1769992222: /artifacts/nightly/1769992222/{nv-smi.txt,dmesg.txt,container.log}. uploaded to CI artifacts.

oliver: I'll start a bisect plan if rerun fails: spin canaries with driver 534.106 and 535.54, and try identical image. if rerun passes, likely a transient OOM/fragmentation — still want to track though.

maria: thanks. if rerun still fails, leave it to oliver + raj to bisect. ping me with results. :thumbsup:

raj: one more quick trick to try in debug rerun: set `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1` and `TF_FORCE_GPU_ALLOW_GROWTH=true` in case it's racing allocator jitter.

maria: noted, adding both to rerun #1769992222-rerun-2 if first rerun fails.

ci-bot: rerun #1769992222-rerun-1 finished: FAILED (same stage). logs: /artifacts/nightly/1769992222-rerun-1/container.log. next: queued rerun-2 with additional env overrides.

maria: ok rerun-1 replicated. moving to bisect. oliver, raj — lmk if you want infra to repro with older driver images.

oliver: starting bisect now. will try 534.106 first on a single node. assigning to myself, will post results in this thread.

maria: thanks all — appreciate the quick turnaround.
